title: Beyond Dialogue Time: Temporal Semantic Memory for Personalized LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2601.07468v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Memory enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to perceive, store, and use information from past dialogues, which is essential for personalization. However, existing methods fail to properly model the temporal dimension of memory in two aspects: 1) Temporal inaccuracy: memories are organized by dialogue time rather than their actual occurrence time; 2) Temporal fragmentation: existing methods focus on point-wise memory, losing durative information that captures persistent states and evolving patterns. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Semantic Memory (TSM), a memory framework that models semantic time for point-wise memory and supports the construction and utilization of durative memory. During memory construction, it first builds a semantic timeline rather than a dialogue one. Then, it consolidates temporally continuous and semantically related information into a durative memory. translated_title: 超越对话时间：面向个性化LLM智能体的时序语义记忆
translated_abstract: 记忆使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够感知、存储和利用来自过去对话的信息，这对个性化至关重要。然而，现有方法未能正确建模记忆的时间维度，主要存在两个问题：1）时间不准确：记忆是按照对话时间而非实际发生时间来组织的；2）时间碎片化：现有方法专注于逐点式记忆，丢失了能够捕捉持续状态和演变模式的持续性信息。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了时序语义记忆（TSM），这是一个为逐点式记忆建模语义时间、并支持持续性记忆构建与利用的记忆框架。在记忆构建阶段，它首先构建语义时间线而非对话时间线，然后将时间上连续且语义相关的信息整合为持续性记忆。在记忆利用阶段，它……
tldr: 提出时序语义记忆（TSM）框架，通过构建语义时间线建模记忆的实际发生时间，并将时间连续且语义相关的信息整合为持续性记忆，解决现有LLM智能体个性化记忆中时间不准确与时间碎片化的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Temporal Semantic Memory (TSM), a framework that builds a semantic timeline to model the actual occurrence time of memories and consolidates temporally continuous, semantically related information into durative memory, addressing temporal inaccuracy and fragmentation in personalized LLM agents.
